module.name: Queue Callback
module.description: Provides queue callback functionality with intelligent processing.
module.changelog: * 17.1.0 - Stable release: verified callback modes and retries; silent blocklist enforcement with Blocked reporting; native FreePBX backup/restore; complete runtime packaging. * 17.0.5.1 Beta 5.1 - Accepting an alternate callback number also confirms and saves the request, removing the second acceptance prompt; add an agent-only beep when a confirmed agent-first call bridges; update configuration help and add menu regression coverage. * 17.0.5.0 Beta 5 - Add returned-call press-1 confirmation, configurable timeout and repeats, invalid-choice prompts and agent failure feedback; install new WAV, mu-law and A-law recordings; fix interrupted initial callback confirmation while preserving its on/off setting; default retries to one minute; improve form labels; harden dispatch, queue ordering/readiness, retries, routes, validation, blocklists, credentials and installation. Beta release; full stable-release verification remains pending. * 17.0.4.6 Beta 4 - Force queue configuration reload for periodic announcements; preserve sound paths and resolve return recordings; fix customer-first callback routing and attach completion after customer answer; leave module files to FreePBX on uninstall; replace callback instruction WAV, mu-law and A-law audio; stop overwriting Queues announcement intervals * 17.0.4.5 Beta 4 - Fixed periodic callback instruction generation on Apply Config and playback for the first waiting caller; added a 30-second default interval and saved frequency selection; preserved Queues breakout IVR routing with callback-key priority; changed the default callback key to # (pound); updated help text, key-conflict warnings, and announcement diagnostics; fixed duplicate security blocklist contexts on repeated configuration generation * 17.0.4.3 Beta 4 - Removed Security from FreePBX top-level menu; security is a tab within queue callback configuration only * 17.0.4.1 Beta 4- Populate Caribbean security defaults when a queue callback is created, install the scheduled report page and menu entry, and include security pages during installation * 17.0.4.0 Beta 4 - Added outbound route selection via from-internal for customer-first callbacks, per-queue security blocklist entries, Enabled tooltip for Add New Entry form * 17.0.3.5 Beta 4 - Added processIntelligentCallbacks method, fixed cron setup for callback processor, updated Qcallback.class.php cron entries to also strip intelligent_processor entries * 17.0.3.5 Beta 3 - Changed default language to Spanish, Reports menu via freepbx_menu.conf * 17.0.3.5 - Added Scheduled Queue Callbacks report page * 17.0.3.4 - Added qcb-complete dialplan context for callback completion * 17.0.3.3 - Fixed alternate number input maxdigits and agent-first callback variable * 17.0.3.2 - Fixed callback routing to use FreePBX outbound route selection * 17.0.3.1 Beta - Bug fixes * 17.0.3.0 Beta - Additions and various bug fixes and improvements * 17.0.2.2 Beta - Fixed bug in process_callback.php in Regex evaluation * 17.0.2.1 Beta - Fixed typos and bugs in agi files * 17.0.2 Beta - Fixed callback completion handler, changed processing interval to seconds, fixed AGI variable names * 17.0.1 Initial Beta release
